# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c38 P25](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril is an exceptionally handsome and good-looking young man with a dark-eyed, distinguished, and polished appearance. He possesses a dark, somber, and refined look with very dark, appealing eyes. His smile is charming and expressive.

_Sources: [v3 c33 P28](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0028), [v3 c34 P11](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0011), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c36 P20](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0020), [v3 c38 P25](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0025)_

## Personality

Cyril is polite, attentive, and romantic, frequently expressing his admiration through refined compliments, poetry, and gifts. He is sensitive, easily hurt, and tends to dramatize his romantic feelings. Although earnest and well-mannered, he lacks a strong sense of humor and can be somewhat light on deeper substance.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004), [v3 c33 P12](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0012), [v3 c35 P9](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0009), [v3 c38 P15](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0015), [v3 c38 P28](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0028)_

## Traits

- handsome and charming  <sub>[v3 c33 P28](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0028), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>
- romantic and poetic  <sub>[v3 c33 P12](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- writing poetry and sonnets

## Goals

- to court and marry Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

Cyril Lisle attended Wexcombe College, though he had to pause his studies for two years to travel in Europe with his mother. Upon returning, he resumed his education and met Nell Harcourt after rescuing her during a rainstorm in the park. He began actively courting Nell, sending her flowers and poetry, and accompanying her to various college functions. His family eventually called on Nell, confirming his intentions toward her. Although many assumed he and Nell would marry, Nell came to realize she did not truly love him. When he proposed to her in the park pavilion, she rejected him. Following her refusal, Cyril was heartbroken but later moved on, eventually marrying another young woman and finding happiness.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028), [v3 c25 P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038), [v3 c33 P22](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0022), [v3 c34 P11](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0011), [v3 c35 P8](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0008), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P21](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0021), [v3 c38 P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032), [v3 c39 P44](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0044)_
